title: Mobile Assisted-Launch System
description: A trailer-mounted assisted-launch concept for fixed-wing UAV field operations. The truss rail, adjustable launch angle, transport chassis, and aircraft interface are packaged as one deployable ground-support system for runway-independent missions.
